# Vendored browser dependencies

Official distributions, pinned for reproducible static GitHub Pages rendering:

| Library | Version | Source | License file |
|---|---|---|---|
| Marked | 15.0.12 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@15.0.12/lib/marked.umd.js | marked-LICENSE |
| DOMPurify | 3.2.7 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.2.7/dist/purify.min.js | dompurify-LICENSE |
| Mermaid | 11.12.0 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.12.0/dist/mermaid.min.js | mermaid-LICENSE |
| highlight.js browser build | 11.11.1 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/highlightjs/cdn-release@11.11.1/build/highlight.min.js | highlight-LICENSE |

`highlight.css` is the GitHub theme from the same highlight.js release. Icons in `../icons/` are from Tabler Icons 3.34.1 and include their MIT license. Markdown is sanitized before insertion; Mermaid uses strict security mode.
